strict_negative_baseline.setup: Isolated source copy restores exact relative-CGRect comparison; same actual fractional fixture page 3 is assembled. No repository source rollback.
strict_negative_baseline.fixed_log: CONFIRMED exact-relative-CGRect baseline rejects the real fractional page with verification error

fractional_geometry.policy: All x/y/width/height components must be finite; abs(expected-actual) <= 4 * max(expected.ulp, actual.ulp). No fixed broad point or percentage epsilon.

limitations: No iOS SDK compilation, hosted XCTest or native picker/export UI execution on this CLT host; CI is required.
Four ULP accounts only for floating-point representation error; other geometry changes still fail verification. Absolute MediaBox origins may be normalized by PDFKit.
Pixel equality is evidence for the synthetic integer/fractional fixtures, not a universal guarantee for arbitrary PDFs.
PDFKit serialization is synchronous and cannot be forcibly interrupted; cancellation prevents late publication.
Serialized-output limit is checked after PDFKit allocation; no hard peak-memory or PDFKit CPU deadline guarantee.
Encrypted documents, unsupported document-wide relationships and selected-page annotations are rejected rather than silently stripped.

Core returns immutable PDF bytes and does not write originals, export, execute, upload or run Python. A separately user-requested native export may replace a selected destination only after native explicit confirmation.

integration_contract.read: authorizeRead(sourceID:) then read(_:) for each selected source
integration_contract.plan: prepare(orderText:) accepts explicit one-based source:page/range components such as 1:3,1:1-2,2:1, preserving interleaving and duplicates
integration_contract.assemble: authorizeAssembly(planID:) then assemble(_:) returns immutable data, plan, pageCount and sha256
integration_contract.cancel: Terminal revocation; replace runtime when selection changes or view closes.
